warnings.headline: DMI warning: Storm surge
warnings.description: Category 1: Storm surge between 1.0 and 1.3 m above normal water level DVR.

warnings.headline: Yellow High sea level South coast of Skåne
warnings.description:
High sea levels and windy weather along the coast pose a local risk of flooding and erosion.; What happens?: During Saturday the sea level will rise to culminate late Saturday evening and night into Sunday at around 90-110 cm in RH 2000. Highest levels are expected in the western part of the warning area. Dropping again from early Sunday morning.
; What should I think about?: Low lying wharfs, jetties, roads or buildings may be exposed to flooding.
Vertical clearance under bridges decreases.
Vulnerable coastal areas may suffer damage from erosion.
Moored vessels are at risk of hull damage.; Where?: From the Öresund Bridge to Simrishamn
warnings.sender: SMHI, Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute

warnings.headline: Yellow Near gale 14-17 m/s Southern Baltic
warnings.description:
Northeast 14-17 m/s. Sunday morning decreasing.; What should I think about?: Pay close attention to the marine forecast and prepare crew and vessel for high winds and seas.
Keep in mind that the wind gusts are often significantly higher than the average wind.; Where?: Southern Baltic
warnings.sender: SMHI, Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute
